pages._note: Article list as a declarative type:index page (marketing-article-hub), opened in cards view: the hero image, title and summary the spec asks for read naturally as a card and only awkwardly as a table row (the card's title/description/image come from the article schema's own `configuration.objectNameField/objectDescriptionField/objectImageField`, not page config). Add navigates to ArticleNew, which mounts the one editing surface the change owns (ArticleEditModal) — the bespoke ArticleService create path (author stamp, slug derivation, the ADR-088 agent-mark refusal) has no declarative equivalent, so `showAdd`/`showFormDialog` stay off. Row view opens ArticleDetail.

pages._note: Mounts ArticleEditModal in create mode (marketing-article-hub). Matches the SegmentNew / TemplateNew / BlastNew convention of a thin route wrapper around the one editing surface the change owns, rather than a second declarative create dialog that could not host CnMarkdownEditor or the Files hero-image picker anyway.

Article record as a declarative type:detail page (ADR-062 grid). The article's own metadata (status, language, author, publication moment, portal page, tags) auto-renders in the 'Article details' data widget. The rendered body, the hero image, the agent-authored mark, the Edit action and the lifecycle moves live in ArticleContentSection (placement before-body, ahead of the data widget, because the body is the reason a marketer opened the page) — see that component's file header and design.md 'The body renders through an in-body section, not a declarative widget' for why: the built-in text widget renders a literal manifest string, not @object.<field>, and only bodyWidgets props carry that token on a detail page. ArticleUsageSection (placement end) answers where the article has been used, joined server-side from two schemas (campaignTemplate, blast) that no single-schema object-list widget can express.
